name: Way of the Spore
description:
Your body is inoculated with mycelial symbiotes, granting you access to all Way of the Spore Abilities.

Whenever you use one of these Abilities, the symbiotes sprout visible fungal growths across your skin. At other times, you may suppress or display these growths as you wish, though a faint, mold-like pattern always remains.

Once per Rest, you may call upon your symbiotes to mend your wounds, reducing your Injury by 2.
